# Online Scout Manager API (Unofficial) — full reference

---

Unofficial, community-driven OpenAPI specification for the
[Online Scout Manager](https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk) (OSM) API —
reverse-engineered from real traffic by the City of Newcastle Scouts Digital Team.

OSM does not publish a public API specification. This project exists to fill
that gap for developers building tools on top of OSM's platform.

> **This documentation is provided as-is with no guarantees.** OSM's API is
> undocumented and can change without notice. Endpoints, parameters, and
> response shapes described here were observed at the time of writing and may
> drift over time. Always test against the live API before relying on
> anything here.

## Authentication

OSM uses **OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code)** for API access. To get started:

1. Log in to OSM and navigate to **Settings → My Account Details → Developer Tools**.
2. Create an OAuth application to obtain your `client_id` and `client_secret`.
3. Implement the standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow — redirect users to
   OSM's authorization endpoint, exchange the code for tokens via `/oauth/token`.
4. Include the access token as a **Bearer token** in the `Authorization` header
   on every API request.
5. Tokens expire — use the refresh token flow to obtain new access tokens.

## Using the API

Your browser uses a simple API for interacting with OSM, so although the API
is unsupported and undocumented, your application can do anything that you can
do on the website.

Use your browser's developer console to watch the network requests made when
you perform the actions you want to automate. Pay particular attention to
whether requests are **GET** or **POST**. Then use your OAuth client library
to create an authenticated request to the URL you discovered (which sets a
Bearer token in the Authorization header).

**Important:** All POST requests must use `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
encoding, **not** JSON. Sending JSON bodies will result in your application
being blocked.

## Rate limits

Please monitor the standard rate limit headers to ensure your application
does not get blocked automatically. Applications that are frequently blocked
will be **permanently blocked**.

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Number of requests per hour your API can perform (per authenticated user) |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining before the current user is blocked |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Seconds until the rate limit resets back to the overall limit |

An **HTTP 429** status code is returned if the user exceeds the limit, along
with a `Retry-After` header indicating the number of seconds to wait.

Please also enforce your own lower rate limits, especially if you allow
unauthenticated users to manipulate your data (e.g. allowing members to join
a waiting list).

## Other considerations

- **Check responses** — abort if they are not as expected. Your application
  will be blocked if it frequently performs invalid requests.
- **`X-Deprecated` header** — anything with this header will be removed after
  the date mentioned. Monitor for it.
- **`X-Blocked` header** — if set, your application has been blocked due to
  invalid data or unauthorized access attempts. Continuing to use the API
  after being blocked will automatically escalate to a **permanent block**.
- **Bot protection** — if you allow unauthenticated use of your application,
  verify users are not bots.
- **Input validation** — always sanitise and validate data before sending it
  to OSM. Invalid data will result in your application being blocked.
- **Privacy and GDPR** — these endpoints return personal data about young
  people and their families. Handle it responsibly. Don't store what you
  don't need, don't log PII, and follow your organisation's data protection
  policies.

---

# OSM API — Startup

Session bootstrap and general metadata.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/generic/startup/` — Get startup data

### GET /ext/generic/startup/

**Get startup data**

Returns startup and session data depending on the `action` parameter.

**`action=getData` has been permanently removed** — this action was removed without
notice. HTTP 410 Gone is the only response you will ever receive for this action.
It will not be reinstated. Migrate to `action=getDataPayload`.

**`action=getDataPayload`** returns a JSON payload containing CDN resource URLs,
user globals, section roles and permissions, user preferences, terms, and session
metadata needed to bootstrap the application after login.

**`action=getConfigPayload`** returns global, non-user-specific site configuration:
section type definitions, patrol role labels, beta features, upgrade pricing, feature
flags, recipe metadata, and form configurations.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getData" \| "getDataPayload" \| "getConfigPayload"` | `getData` — **permanently removed**, HTTP 410 Gone is the only reply. `getDataPayload` — returns the full JSON startup payload. `getConfigPayload` — returns global site configuration. |

**Response 200** — JSON startup payload (schema varies by `action`; see examples).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    cdn?: string;  // Base CDN URL for static assets.
    resources?: string[];  // Ordered list of JS/CSS resource paths to load on startup.
    config_hash?: string;  // Hash representing the current server-side configuration state.
    required_cdn_built_files?: Record<string, string>;  // Named CDN file URLs required for the app (e.g., `osm.js`, `react.js`).
    cache_bust?: string;  // Query string cache-busting token derived from built file hashes.
    globals?: {
      post_login_action?: boolean | string;  // Action to perform after login, or `false` if none.
      theme?: string;  // UI theme name (e.g., `blue`).
      userid?: integer;  // Authenticated user's numeric ID.
      roles?: {
        groupname?: string;
        groupid?: string;
        group_country?: string;
        sectionid?: string;
        sectionname?: string;
        section?: string;  // Section type slug (e.g., `cubs`, `scouts`, `adults`, `waiting`).
        isDefault?: string;
        permissions?: Record<string, any>;
        sectionConfig?: Record<string, any>;
        [key: string]: any;
      }[];  // Sections the user has access to, including permissions and config.
      active_user_member?: boolean | integer;  // Whether the user is also a member record, or `false`.
      associated_member_id?: boolean | integer;  // Associated member ID if applicable, or `false`.
      email?: string;
      firstname?: string;
      lastname?: string;
      fullname?: string;
      preferences?: Record<string, any>;  // User-specific UI and behavioural preferences.
      member_access?: Record<string, Record<string, any>>;  // Sections where the user has parent-portal member access, keyed by section ID.
      member_access_unactivated?: boolean | Record<string, any>;  // Whether any member access is pending activation.
      terms?: Record<string, {
        termid?: string;
        sectionid?: string;
        name?: string;
        startdate?: string;
        enddate?: string;
        master_term?: any | null;
        past?: boolean;
        [key: string]: any;
      }[]>;  // Terms for each section, keyed by section ID.
      global_roles?: Record<string, any>[];
      hasSectionAccess?: boolean;
      notepads?: Record<string, any>[];
      sockets?: string;  // Comma-separated `sectionid-token` pairs for WebSocket connections.
      user_socket?: string;  // Personal WebSocket token for the authenticated user.
      session_id?: string;
      security_prompt?: boolean;
      user_has_image?: string;  // Path to the user's profile photo.
      user_hash?: string;  // HMAC hash used for client-side identity verification.
      user_hash_legacy?: string;
      language?: string;
      gamification?: Record<string, {
        total_steps?: integer;
        steps_completed?: integer;
        id?: integer | string;
        [key: string]: any;
      }>;
      gamification_rank?: integer;
      gamification_total?: integer;
      features_used?: string[];  // Log of feature interactions recorded for this user account.
      unread_message_count?: integer;
      client_time?: string;  // Client Unix timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the request.
      [key: string]: any;
    };
    dojo?: {
      cacheBust?: string;
      locale?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    site_type?: string;  // Site variant identifier (e.g., `scouts`).
    site_folder?: string;  // Server-side folder path for site-specific assets.
    siteConfig?: {
      expense_cards?: Record<string, any>;
      online_payment_gateways?: string[];
      beta?: {
        key?: string;
        title?: string;
        description?: string;
        role?: string;
        release_ts?: integer;
        feedback?: Record<string, any>;
        [key: string]: any;
      }[];  // Beta features available for opt-in.
      boltons?: Record<string, string>;  // Short-code to bolton name mapping.
      upgrade_config?: Record<string, {
        price?: number;
      }>;  // Subscription feature prices, keyed by feature name.
      sms_prices?: Record<string, number>;  // SMS bundle prices keyed by credit quantity.
      recipes?: Record<string, string[]>;  // Enumerated values for the recipe planner.
      section_types?: Record<string, Record<string, string>>;  // Human-readable section type names keyed by country code then section type slug.
      badge_types?: Record<string, string[]>;
      section_type_setup?: Record<string, Record<string, any>>;  // Per-section-type capability flags and badge definitions.
      kill?: Record<string, boolean>;  // Feature kill-switch states (all `false` means all services active).
      buy_links?: Record<string, string>;
      risk_assessments_config?: Record<string, any>;
      communicatable_contact_groups?: Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
      email_template_colours?: string[];
      campaign_template_designs?: string[];
      remove_member_allowed_functions?: Record<string, string[]>;
      [key: string]: any;
    };  // Global feature flags, upgrade pricing, section type definitions, and configuration.
    patrolLabels?: Record<string, {
      patrol?: string;
      patrols?: string;
    }>;  // Patrol/group label names per section type.
    patrolRoles?: Record<string, Record<string, any>[] | Record<string, Record<string, any>>>;  // Patrol role definitions per section type. Youth sections use an array ordered by level; adult sections use an object keyed by level number.
    extraSectionTypes?: Record<string, string>;  // Display names for non-standard section types.
    featurelevels?: Record<string, integer>;  // Minimum subscription level required to access each feature.
    changedlevels?: Record<string, any>[];
    availableRoles?: Record<string, string>;  // Global role slugs mapped to display names.
    globalAccessRoles?: {
      user_role?: string;
      access_type?: string;
      id?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }[];  // Access control rules granting global roles specific access types.
    terminology?: Record<string, string>;  // Hierarchy level names for the site (Group, District, County, etc.).
    forms?: Record<string, any>[];  // Dynamic form definitions (accident forms, medication history, etc.).
    default_terminology?: Record<string, string>;
    leaderPatrolIds?: integer[];  // Patrol IDs reserved for leaders (typically -2 and -3).
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

---

# OSM API — Members

Member lists, details, patrols, and census.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/members/contact/` — Get list of members or individual member details
- `POST /ext/members/contact/` — Update a member field or contact details
- `POST /ext/members/contact/actions/` — Create, remove, or restore a member
- `GET /ext/members/patrols/` — Get patrols with members
- `POST /ext/members/patrols/` — Update patrol points
- `GET /ext/members/census/` — Get census details
- `GET /ext/members/flexirecords/` — Get flexi-records, their structure, or their data
- `POST /ext/audittrail/` — Get audit trail for a member
- `POST /v3/members/contact/{sectionid}/removalWarnings` — Get pre-removal warnings for a member
- `GET /v3/members/review/deletion/{sectionid}` — Get deletable members
- `GET /v3/members/review/elsewhere/{sectionid}` — Get members who left this section and are elsewhere
- `GET /v3/members/review/future_transfers/{sectionid}` — Get scheduled (future) member transfers
- `GET /ext/settings/parents/loginhistory/` — Get Parent Portal login history

### GET /ext/members/contact/

**Get list of members or individual member details**

Retrieves member data. The `action` parameter controls the behavior.
This endpoint is also used to return full member contact/emergency data
(use with care for GDPR compliance).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getListOfMembers" \| "getIndividual" \| "getMemberTransfers"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | no | `string` | Term ID. |
| `section` | query | no | `"squirrels" \| "beavers" \| "cubs" \| "scouts" \| "explorers"` | Section type. |
| `sort` | query | no | `"dob" \| "firstname" \| "lastname" \| "patrol"` | Sort order for list of members. |
| `scoutid` | query | no | `string` | Member unique identifier. |
| `context` | query | no | `"members"` | Context for member detail retrieval. |
| `mode` | query | no | `string` | Display mode (observed value `grid`). |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (alternate naming). |

**Response 200** — Member data response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  identifier: string;
  photos?: boolean;
  items: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  ok?: boolean;
  read_only?: string[];
  data?: Record<string, any>;
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: Record<string, any>[];
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Members list:

```json
{
  "identifier": "scoutid",
  "photos": true,
  "items": [
    {
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "patrolid": 12001,
      "patrol": "Blue",
      "sectionid": 45001,
      "enddate": null,
      "age": "10 / 2",
      "patrol_role_level_label": "Sixer",
      "active": true,
      "scoutid": 3100001,
      "full_name": "Jamie River",
      "has_invitations": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Member detail:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "read_only": [],
  "data": {
    "scoutid": "3100001",
    "firstname": "Jamie",
    "lastname": "River",
    "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
    "dob": "2015-04-22",
    "started": "2021-09-01",
    "created_date": "2021-09-01 18:30:00",
    "last_accessed": "2025-09-15 19:00:00",
    "patrolid": "12001",
    "patrolleader": "2",
    "startedsection": "2021-09-01",
    "enddate": null,
    "age": "10 years and 4 months",
    "age_simple": "10 / 04",
    "sectionid": 45001,
    "active": true,
    "has_invitations": false,
    "moving_on_date": "2025-12-19",
    "moving_on_section_name": "Scouts"
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

Example — Member transfers:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "direction": "from",
      "member_id": 3100002,
      "firstname": "Riley",
      "lastname": "Park",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "type": "transferred",
      "date": "2024-01-15",
      "section_id": 65001,
      "section_name": {
        "group": "1st Riverside Scouts",
        "section": "Scouts"
      },
      "section_long": "1st Riverside Scouts: Scouts",
      "mode": "outgoing",
      "id": "outgoing-123456"
    }
  ],
  "meta": []
}
```

### POST /ext/members/contact/

**Update a member field or contact details**

Updates a single field on a member record, or updates contact details
for one of their linked contacts. The `action` query parameter must be
`update`. The body is sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

**Member field mode** — send `scoutid`, `column`, `value`, `sectionid`,
and optionally `context=members` (the web UI's patrol drag-and-drop
omits `context` and still succeeds). Known columns:

| Column          | Value format | Notes |
|-----------------|-------------|-------|
| `firstname`     | string | |
| `lastname`      | string | |
| `dob`           | `yyyy-mm-dd` | |
| `started`       | `yyyy-mm-dd` | Date started Scouting. |
| `startedsection`| `yyyy-mm-dd` | Date started this section. |
| `patrolid`      | int | Must also provide `patrolleader` in the same request body. |
| `patrolleader`  | int | 0 = no rank, 1 = APL/Seconder, 2 = PL/Sixer, 3 = SPL/Senior Sixer. |

When setting `patrolid`, the body **must also include** `patrolleader`
(the rank level integer). Conversely, `patrolleader` can be set on its
own as `column` without changing the patrol.

**Contact update mode** — send `associated_type=member`,
`associated_id=<scoutid>`, `group_id=<contact_group>`, `context=members`,
and `data[field]=value` pairs for each field. Contact group IDs:

| group_id | Contact |
|----------|---------|
| 1 | Primary Contact 1 |
| 2 | Primary Contact 2 |
| 3 | Emergency Contact |
| 4 | Doctor's Surgery |
| 6 | Member's own details |

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"update"` | Must be `update`. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  scoutid?: integer;  // Member unique identifier (member field mode).
  column?: "firstname" | "lastname" | "dob" | "started" | "startedsection" | "patrolid" | "patrolleader";  // The field to update (member field mode).
  value?: integer | string;  // The new value.
  sectionid?: string;  // Section ID the member belongs to.
  context?: "members";  // Must be `members`.
  patrolleader?: integer;  // Required when `column=patrolid`. Rank level: 0 = none, 1 = APL/Seconder, 2 = PL/Sixer, 3 = SPL/Senior Sixer.
  associated_type?: "member";  // Contact update mode — must be `member`.
  associated_id?: integer;  // Contact update mode — the member's scoutid.
  group_id?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 6;  // Contact update mode — contact group ID.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Update a member field (e.g. patrol):

```json
{
  "scoutid": 3100001,
  "column": "patrolid",
  "value": "12002",
  "sectionid": "45001",
  "context": "members",
  "patrolleader": 0
}
```

Example — Update a contact's details:

```json
{
  "associated_type": "member",
  "associated_id": "3100001",
  "group_id": "1",
  "context": "members",
  "data[firstname]": "Morwenna",
  "data[lastname]": "River",
  "data[email1]": "morwenna.river@example.org",
  "data[phone1]": "07700900123",
  "data[phone1_sms]": "yes"
}
```

**Response 200** — Update confirmation with last-updated metadata.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  ok?: boolean;
  meta?: {
    last_updated?: string;  // Timestamp of the update (e.g. `2025-09-15 19:42:10`).
    last_updated_by_name?: string;  // Name of the user who made the update.
  };
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "meta": {
    "last_updated": "2025-09-15 19:42:10",
    "last_updated_by_name": "Alex Scout"
  }
}
```

### POST /ext/members/contact/actions/

**Create, remove, or restore a member**

Member lifecycle actions. The `action` query parameter controls the
behaviour. Body is `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

**`newMember`** — creates a new member in the section.

**`removeMember`** — removes a member from the section. The `type`
field controls how much data is retained:

| type | Effect |
|------|--------|
| `keepall` | Keep all data intact |
| `keepcontact` | Remove personal details except name and core details |
| `keepname` | Remove personal details except name |
| `delete` | Remove all personal details; use initials for names (member history retains names) |
| `erase` | Remove all personal details **including** names from history. **Irreversible.** |

When `type=erase`, an optional `additional_data_to_delete` array can
specify extra data categories to purge: `badge`, `events`, `finance`,
`register`. Each is optional.

**`returnMember`** — restores a previously removed member.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"newMember" \| "removeMember" \| "returnMember"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (required for `removeMember`). |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  firstname?: string;  // `newMember` only. First name.
  lastname?: string;  // `newMember` only. Last name.
  dob?: string /* date */;  // `newMember` only. Date of birth (`yyyy-mm-dd`).
  startedsection?: string /* date */;  // `newMember` only. Date started in this section.
  started?: string /* date */;  // `newMember` only. Date started Scouting.
  sectionid?: string;  // Section ID.
  originating_section_id?: string;  // `newMember` only. Usually same as `sectionid`.
  term_id?: string;  // `newMember` only. Term ID.
  scouts?: integer;  // `removeMember` / `returnMember`. Member scout ID.
  from_section?: string;  // `removeMember` only. Section ID to remove from.
  date?: string /* date */;  // `removeMember` only. Effective removal date (`yyyy-mm-dd`).
  type?: "keepall" | "keepcontact" | "keepname" | "delete" | "erase";  // `removeMember` only. Data retention level.
  additional_data_to_delete?: ("badge" | "events" | "finance" | "register")[];  // `removeMember` with `type=erase` only. Extra data to purge.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Create a new member:

```json
{
  "firstname": "Rowan",
  "lastname": "Wells",
  "dob": "2016-06-15",
  "startedsection": "2025-09-05",
  "started": "2025-09-06",
  "sectionid": "45001",
  "originating_section_id": "45001",
  "term_id": "67890"
}
```

Example — Remove a member (keep all data):

```json
{
  "scouts": 3100005,
  "from_section": "45001",
  "date": "2025-08-19",
  "type": "keepall"
}
```

Example — Restore a removed member:

```json
{
  "scouts": 3100005
}
```

**Response 200** — Action result.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  result?: "ok";
  out_of_term?: boolean;  // Whether the start date falls outside the given term.
  scoutid?: integer;  // The newly assigned member ID.
  firstname?: string;
  lastname?: string;
} | {
  ok?: boolean;
  scouts?: integer[];  // Scout IDs affected.
}
```

Example — New member created:

```json
{
  "result": "ok",
  "out_of_term": false,
  "scoutid": 3100005,
  "firstname": "Rowan",
  "lastname": "Wells"
}
```

Example — Member removed:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "scouts": [
    3100005
  ]
}
```

Example — Member restored:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "scouts": [
    3100005
  ]
}
```

### GET /ext/members/patrols/

**Get patrols with members**

Returns patrols (sixes, lodges, etc.) keyed by patrol ID, each with its
members. Negative IDs are pseudo-patrols: `-2` = Leaders, `-3` = Young
Leaders. Members with a rank also carry `patrol_role_level` (the numeric
rank, matching `patrolleader`) and `patrol_role_level_abbr` (e.g. `6er`,
`2nd`); the `patrol` field then includes the abbreviation (e.g. `Blue 6er`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getPatrolsWithPeople"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | yes | `string` | Term ID. |
| `include_no_patrol` | query | no | `"y" \| "n"` | Include pseudo-patrol for members not in a patrol. |

**Response 200** — Patrol list keyed by patrol ID.

`application/json`:

```ts
Record<string, any>
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "12001": {
    "patrolid": "12001",
    "sectionid": "45001",
    "name": "Blue",
    "active": "1",
    "points": "2",
    "census_costs": false,
    "members": [
      {
        "firstname": "Jamie",
        "lastname": "River",
        "scout_id": 3100001,
        "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
        "patrolid": 12001,
        "patrolleader": "2",
        "patrol": "Blue 6er",
        "sectionid": 45001,
        "enddate": null,
        "age": "10 / 2",
        "patrol_role_level_label": "Sixer",
        "active": 1,
        "scoutid": 3100001,
        "patrol_role_level_abbr": "6er",
        "patrol_role_level": 2,
        "editable": true
      }
    ]
  },
  "-3": {
    "patrolid": "-3",
    "sectionid": "-2",
    "name": "Young Leaders (YLs)",
    "active": "1",
    "points": "0",
    "census_costs": false,
    "members": []
  },
  "-2": {
    "patrolid": "-2",
    "sectionid": "-2",
    "name": "Leaders",
    "active": "1",
    "points": "0",
    "census_costs": false,
    "members": []
  }
}
```

### POST /ext/members/patrols/

**Update patrol points**

Sets the points total for a patrol. `points` is the **new total**, not an
increment. The response body is an empty JSON array on success.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"updatePatrolPoints"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  patrolid: string;  // Patrol ID.
  points: string;  // New points total.
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "patrolid": "12001",
  "points": "3"
}
```

**Response 200** — Empty array on success.

`application/json`:

```ts
any[]
```

Example — example:

```json
[]
```

### GET /ext/members/census/

**Get census details**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getDetails"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | yes | `string` | Term ID. |

**Response 200** — Census detail response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  identifier?: string;
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "identifier": "scoutid",
  "items": [
    {
      "scoutid": "3100003",
      "firstname": "Sam",
      "lastname": "Lake",
      "joined": "2022-03-01",
      "photo_guid": null,
      "sex": "",
      "ethnicity": "",
      "disabilities": "Edit disabilities",
      "myscout": "Send Parent Portal email",
      "raw_disabilities": [],
      "_filterString": "sam lake"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /ext/members/flexirecords/

**Get flexi-records, their structure, or their data**

Flexi-records are section-defined spreadsheets of extra per-member data.

- `getFlexiRecords` — lists the section's flexi-records (`extraid` + `name`).
- `getStructure` — returns a flexi-record's definition. `config` is a
  JSON-encoded string of column definitions (`[{"id":"f_1","name":"…"}]`)
  and `structure` is the Dojo grid layout (a frozen name block, then the
  editable `f_N` columns).
- `getData` — returns one row per member for a term, with each custom
  column under its `f_N` key, plus `total` / `completed` summary columns.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getFlexiRecords" \| "getStructure" \| "getData"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `archived` | query | no | `"y" \| "n"` | `getFlexiRecords` — include archived flexi-records. |
| `extraid` | query | no | `string` | Flexi-record ID (required for `getStructure` and `getData`). |
| `termid` | query | no | `string` | Term ID (required for `getData`). |
| `nototal` | query | no | `string` | `getData` — observed sent empty. |

**Response 200** — Flexi-record list, structure, or data.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  identifier?: string;
  label?: string;
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | Record<string, any>
```

Example — Flexi-record list (action=getFlexiRecords):

```json
{
  "identifier": "extraid",
  "label": "name",
  "items": [
    {
      "extraid": "23001",
      "name": "Hike Log"
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Flexi-record structure (action=getStructure):

```json
{
  "extraid": "23001",
  "sectionid": "45002",
  "name": "Hike Log",
  "config": "[{\"id\":\"f_1\",\"name\":\"Distance (km)\",\"width\":\"150\"}]",
  "total": "none",
  "extrafields": "[]",
  "archived": "0",
  "soft_deleted": "0",
  "archived_at": null,
  "structure": [
    {
      "rows": [
        {
          "name": "First Name",
          "field": "firstname",
          "width": "150px",
          "formatter": "boldFormatter"
        },
        {
          "name": "Last Name",
          "field": "lastname",
          "width": "150px"
        }
      ],
      "noscroll": true
    },
    {
      "rows": [
        {
          "name": "Distance (km)",
          "field": "f_1",
          "width": "150px",
          "formatter": "boldFormatter",
          "editable": true
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Flexi-record data (action=getData):

```json
{
  "identifier": "scoutid",
  "items": [
    {
      "scoutid": "3100001",
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "dob": "2015-04-22",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "patrolid": "12001",
      "total": "",
      "completed": "",
      "f_1": "12",
      "age": "10 / 04",
      "patrol": "Blue",
      "_filterString": "jamie river"
    }
  ]
}
```

### POST /ext/audittrail/

**Get audit trail for a member**

Returns the audit trail (change history) for a member. Despite being
a POST, this is a read-only query — the body specifies which member
to look up. The response contains a chronological list of changes
including patrol moves, rank promotions, field edits, and section
additions.

Each entry has a `type` and `code` describing the kind of change:

| type | code | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| `members` | `add` | Member added to section |
| `details` | `field` | A member field was edited |
| `details` | `new` | A new detail was added (e.g. consent) |
| `patrols` | `add-to` | Member added to a patrol/six |
| `patrol-leader` | `promoted` | Rank promotion or demotion |

The `summary` field contains HTML with `<strong>` tags highlighting
names, fields, and values.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getAuditTrail"` | Must be `getAuditTrail`. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  section_id: string;  // Section ID (repeated in body).
  id: string;  // Member scout ID.
  type: "member";  // Must be `member`.
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "section_id": "45001",
  "id": "3100001",
  "type": "member"
}
```

**Response 200** — Audit trail entries for the member.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    date?: string;  // Human-readable date (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM).
    date_raw?: string;  // Raw timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).
    summary?: string;  // HTML summary of the change with `<strong>` highlights.
    verbose?: string;  // Extended details (usually empty).
    type?: "members" | "details" | "patrols" | "patrol-leader";  // Category of change.
    code?: "add" | "field" | "new" | "add-to" | "promoted";  // Specific action within the category.
    hidden?: boolean;
  }[];
  meta?: {
    hidden?: boolean;
    note_types?: string[];  // Available note type filters.
  };
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "date": "15/09/2025 19:42",
      "date_raw": "2025-09-15 19:42:10",
      "summary": "<strong>Jamie River</strong> has had their <strong>Consents: Photographs</strong> added as <strong>Yes</strong> by <strong>Alex Scout</strong>",
      "verbose": "",
      "type": "details",
      "code": "new",
      "hidden": false
    },
    {
      "date": "15/09/2025 19:38",
      "date_raw": "2025-09-15 19:38:31",
      "summary": "<strong>Jamie River</strong> is now a <strong>Sixer</strong> in the Blue six in <strong>Cubs</strong> (previously <strong>Seconder</strong>), changed by <strong>Alex Scout</strong>.",
      "verbose": "",
      "type": "patrol-leader",
      "code": "promoted",
      "hidden": false
    },
    "… 3 more"
  ],
  "meta": {
    "hidden": false,
    "note_types": [
      "notes",
      "received-email",
      "… 5 more"
    ]
  }
}
```

### POST /v3/members/contact/{sectionid}/removalWarnings

**Get pre-removal warnings for a member**

Checks whether there are any warnings before removing a member from a
section (e.g. outstanding payments). Call this before `removeMember`
to display confirmation prompts to the user.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  "member_ids[0]": integer;  // Scout ID of the member to check. Additional members can be sent as `member_ids[1]`, `member_ids[2]`, etc.
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "member_ids[0]": 3100005
}
```

**Response 200** — Removal warnings.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    payments?: boolean;  // Whether the member has outstanding payments.
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  meta?: {
    ok?: boolean;
  };
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "payments": false
  },
  "meta": {
    "ok": true
  }
}
```

```ts
  [key: string]: any;
```
```json
}
```

### GET /ext/settings/parents/loginhistory/

# OSM API — Attendance

Member attendance and badge requirements.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/members/attendance/` — Get attendance data, register structure, or badge requirements
- `POST /ext/members/attendance/` — Update attendance
- `POST /v3/members/attendance/visitors/{sectionid}` — Add or update a register visitor

### GET /ext/members/attendance/

**Get attendance data, register structure, or badge requirements**

Attendance endpoints share this path with different `action` values.

- `get` — the register: one row per member with a `yyyy-mm-dd` key for
  each meeting they have a mark for (`Yes` / `No`), plus `meetings`
  (date → meeting title), `visitors` and `parent_rota` (both objects,
  empty when unused).
- `structure` — the Dojo grid layout for the register: a frozen name
  block, then one column per meeting date (`tooltip` is the meeting title).
- `getAttendanceBadgeRequirements` — badge requirements linked to the
  meeting on `date`. With `v=2` the response is an object with `badges`
  (the requirements) and `badges_updated_at` (who last changed the
  meeting's badge links); without `v` an array of requirements is returned.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"get" \| "structure" \| "getAttendanceBadgeRequirements"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | no | `string` | Term ID (required for `get` and `structure`). |
| `section` | query | yes | `string` | Section type (e.g., `cubs`). |
| `nototal` | query | no | `string` | Toggle total attendance column (observed `true`). |
| `date` | query | no | `string` | Meeting date (required for `action=getAttendanceBadgeRequirements`). |
| `v` | query | no | `"2"` | `getAttendanceBadgeRequirements` — response version. `2` returns the `{badges, badges_updated_at}` object. |

**Response 200** — Attendance, structure, or badge requirement response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  identifier?: string;
  label?: string;
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  meetings?: Record<string, string>;
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  badge?: string;
  badge_id?: string;
  badge_version?: string;
  column_id?: string;
  badgeName?: string;
  badgetype?: string;
  columngroup?: string;
  columnname?: string;
  description?: string;
  data?: string;
  eveningid?: integer;
  meetingdate?: string;
  link_from?: string;
  name?: string;
  section?: string;
  sameas_counter?: integer;
  sectionid?: integer;
  [key: string]: any;
}[] | {
  badges?: {
    badge?: string;
    badge_id?: string;
    badge_version?: string;
    column_id?: string;
    badgeName?: string;
    badgetype?: string;
    columngroup?: string;
    columnname?: string;
    description?: string;
    data?: string;
    eveningid?: integer;
    meetingdate?: string;
    link_from?: string;
    name?: string;
    section?: string;
    sameas_counter?: integer;
    sectionid?: integer;
    [key: string]: any;
  }[];
  badges_updated_at?: {
    user_name?: string;
    date_time?: string;  // `dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm`.
  }[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  rows?: Record<string, any>[];
  noscroll?: boolean;
  [key: string]: any;
}[]
```

Example — Attendance list (action=get):

```json
{
  "identifier": "scoutid",
  "label": "name",
  "items": [
    {
      "2025-01-07": "Yes",
      "2025-01-14": "No",
      "total": 1,
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "patrolid": 12001,
      "patrolleader": "2",
      "patrol": "Blue",
      "dob": "2015-04-22",
      "sectionid": 45002,
      "startdate": "2021-09-01",
      "enddate": null,
      "age": "10 / 04",
      "patrol_role_level_label": "Sixer",
      "active": true,
      "scoutid": 3100001,
      "_filterString": "jamie river blue"
    },
    {
      "2025-01-07": "Yes",
      "total": 1,
      "firstname": "Robert",
      "lastname": "Baden Powell",
      "patrolid": -2,
      "patrol": "Leaders",
      "active": true,
      "scoutid": 3100010
    }
  ],
  "visitors": {},
  "parent_rota": {},
  "meetings": {
    "2025-01-07": "Welcome Back!",
    "2025-01-14": "Camp Skills Night"
  }
}
```

Example — Register grid layout (action=structure):

```json
[
  {
    "rows": [
      {
        "name": "First Name",
        "field": "firstname",
        "width": "100px",
        "formatter": "registerBoldFormatter"
      },
      {
        "name": "Last Name",
        "field": "lastname",
        "width": "100px",
        "formatter": "registerBoldFormatter"
      }
    ],
    "noscroll": true
  },
  {
    "rows": [
      {
        "name": "2025-01-07",
        "field": "2025-01-07",
        "formatter": "doneFormatter",
        "width": "110px",
        "tooltip": "Welcome Back!"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

Example — Attendance badge requirements (v=2):

```json
{
  "badges": [
    {
      "badge": "0",
      "badge_id": "1002",
      "badge_version": "0",
      "column_id": "200101",
      "badgeName": "Chef",
      "badgetype": "activity",
      "columngroup": "A",
      "columnname": "a",
      "description": "Learn about the main food groups.",
      "data": "14/01/2025",
      "eveningid": 9500002,
      "meetingdate": "2025-01-14",
      "link_from": "meeting",
      "name": "Food Groups",
      "section": "cubs",
      "sameas_counter": 0,
      "sectionid": 45002
    }
  ],
  "badges_updated_at": [
    {
      "user_name": "Alex Scout",
      "date_time": "14/01/2025 20:40"
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Attendance badge requirements (no v parameter):

```json
[
  {
    "badge_id": "1593",
    "badgeName": "Communicator",
    "column_id": "100542",
    "name": "Code",
    "meetingdate": "2025-01-14",
    "section": "cubs",
    "sectionid": 12345
  }
]
```

### POST /ext/members/attendance/

**Update attendance**

Marks one or more members present/absent for a meeting date, optionally
awarding the badge requirements linked to that meeting. The response
body is the bare JSON literal `true` on success.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"update"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `termid` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  scouts: string;  // JSON array of member IDs.
  selectedDate: string;
  present: string;  // `Yes`, `No`, or `Absent` (observed).
  section: string;
  sectionid: string;
  completedBadges?: string;  // JSON array of badge data.
  customData?: string;  // JSON array of custom data updates.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "scouts": "[3100001]",
  "selectedDate": "2025-01-14",
  "present": "Yes",
  "section": "cubs",
  "sectionid": "45002",
  "completedBadges": "[]",
  "customData": "[]"
}
```

**Response 200** — The JSON literal `true` on success.

`application/json`:

```ts
boolean
```

Example — example:

```json
true
```

### POST /v3/members/attendance/visitors/{sectionid}

**Add or update a register visitor**

Records a non-member visitor (or parent helper) against a meeting date.
Visitors appear in the `visitors` object of
`GET /ext/members/attendance/?action=get`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  name: string;  // Visitor's name (free text).
  meeting_date: string /* date */;
  present: "Yes" | "No";
  type: string;  // Observed `visitor`.
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "name": "Visiting Leader",
  "meeting_date": "2025-01-14",
  "present": "Yes",
  "type": "visitor"
}
```

**Response 200** — Visitor saved.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": []
}
```

# OSM API — Custom Data

Custom data groups and updates.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/customdata/` — Get custom data for a member
- `POST /ext/customdata/` — Update custom data for a member

### GET /ext/customdata/

**Get custom data for a member**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getData"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `associated_id` | query | yes | `string` | Member ID. |
| `associated_type` | query | yes | `"member"` |  |
| `associated_is_section` | query | no | `string` | Section association flag (observed null). |
| `varname_filter` | query | no | `string` | Filter by variable name (observed null). |
| `context` | query | yes | `"members"` |  |
| `group_order` | query | no | `string` | Group ordering (observed "section"). |

**Response 200** — Custom data groups and columns.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    group_id?: integer;
    config?: Record<string, any> | null;
    group_type?: string;
    identifier?: string;
    name?: string;
    description?: string;
    description_mymember?: string;
    is_considered_core?: string;
    allow_new_columns?: string;
    display?: string;
    columns?: {
      column_id?: integer;
      type?: string;
      required?: string;
      display_in_advanced_view?: string;
      display_if_empty?: string;
      hide_from_group_display?: string;
      config?: Record<string, any>;
      varname?: string;
      label?: string;
      value?: any | null;
      is_core?: string;
      order?: string;
      force_read_only?: string;
      special_permissions?: string;
      permissions?: string[];
      orig_label?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }[];
    custom_order?: integer;
    [key: string]: any;
  }[];
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "group_id": 7,
      "group_type": "floating",
      "identifier": "floating",
      "name": "Other",
      "columns": [
        {
          "column_id": 34,
          "type": "select",
          "varname": "gender",
          "label": "Gender",
          "value": "Male"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "group_name": "1st Riverside Scouts",
    "section_name": "Cubs"
  }
}
```

### POST /ext/customdata/

**Update custom data for a member**

Updates custom data fields on a member. Two `action` values are supported:

- `update` — bulk update using `data[field]=value` pairs (e.g. contact details).
- `updateColumn` — update a single custom data column by `column_id`.

Column IDs are section-specific. The only well-known core column is
`column_id=34` for Gender (values: Male, Female, Self-identify,
Prefer not to say, Other, Unspecified). Other column IDs vary per
section — inspect HTTP traffic to discover them.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"update" \| "updateColumn"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  associated_id?: string;  // Member scout ID.
  associated_type?: "member";
  associated_is_section?: string;  // Section association flag (observed `false`).
  group_id?: string;  // Custom data group ID. For `update` action this matches the contact group (1–6). For `updateColumn` this is the custom data group containing the column.
  column_id?: integer;  // Column ID to update (`updateColumn` action only).
  value?: string;  // New value for the column (`updateColumn` action only).
  context?: "members";
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Bulk update contact details (action=update):

```json
{
  "associated_id": "3100003",
  "associated_type": "member",
  "group_id": "2",
  "context": "members",
  "service": "desktop",
  "data[firstname]": "Hazel",
  "data[lastname]": "Park"
}
```

Example — Update a single custom column (action=updateColumn):

```json
{
  "associated_type": "member",
  "associated_id": "3100005",
  "associated_is_section": "false",
  "group_id": "7",
  "column_id": 34,
  "value": "Male",
  "context": "members"
}
```

**Response 200** — Custom data update response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: Record<string, any>;
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: {
    column_id?: integer;
    type?: string;  // Column type (e.g. `select`, `text`).
    required?: "yes" | "no";
    varname?: string;  // Variable name (e.g. `gender`).
    label?: string;  // Human-readable label.
    value?: string;  // The updated value.
    is_core?: "yes" | "no";
    order?: string;
    config?: Record<string, any>;  // Column configuration including options for select fields.
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  meta?: {
    last_updated?: {
      last_updated?: string;
      last_updated_by_name?: string;
    };
  };
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Bulk update response:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "lastname": "Park"
  },
  "meta": {
    "last_updated": {
      "last_updated": "2025-09-12 18:30:45",
      "last_updated_by_name": "Alex Scout"
    },
    "updated": {
      "lastname": "Last Name"
    }
  }
}
```

Example — Column update response:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "column_id": 34,
    "type": "select",
    "required": "no",
    "varname": "gender",
    "label": "Gender",
    "value": "Male",
    "is_core": "yes",
    "order": "12"
  },
  "meta": {
    "last_updated": {
      "last_updated": "2025-09-15 19:43:22",
      "last_updated_by_name": "Alex Scout"
    }
  }
}
```


---

# OSM API — Email

Member contact email selection and templates.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/members/email/` — Get selected contact emails, or the email attachments manifest
- `POST /ext/members/email/` — Resolve recipient emails or send an email
- `GET /ext/settings/emails/` — Get email configuration or delivery reports for a section
- `GET /ext/members/email/campaigns/` — List email campaign templates
- `GET /v3/members/email/campaigns/snippets/{campaignId}` — Get a campaign's content snippets
- `GET /v3/members/email/compose/{sectionid}` — Get members for the email composer
- `GET /v3/members/email/draft/{sectionid}` — List draft emails
- `POST /v3/members/email/draft` — Save a draft email
- `GET /ext/members/sms/` — Get SMS delivery report

### GET /ext/members/email/

**Get selected contact emails, or the email attachments manifest**

- `getSelectedEmailsFromContacts` — resolves the email addresses for every
  member in the section using their default contact groups. The web UI
  now sends this as a **POST** with an explicit member list (see below);
  the GET form is kept here as previously observed.
- `emailerAttachmentsManifest` — returns the attachment manifest for an
  email being composed. The `guid` / `id` identify the draft (the same
  GUID later sent to `sendTemplate` and `/v3/members/email/draft`). See
  [File manifests](#tag/Files) for the response shape.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getSelectedEmailsFromContacts" \| "emailerAttachmentsManifest"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`getSelectedEmailsFromContacts`). |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`emailerAttachmentsManifest`). |
| `id` | query | no | `string /* uuid */` | Draft email GUID (`emailerAttachmentsManifest`). |
| `guid` | query | no | `string /* uuid */` | Draft email GUID — same value as `id` (`emailerAttachmentsManifest`). |
| `path` | query | no | `string` | Directory within the manifest (observed `/`). |
| `temp` | query | no | `"true" \| "false"` | Include uncommitted (temporary) uploads. |

**Response 200** — Selected emails for contacts, or a file manifest.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  emails?: Record<string, {
    emails?: string[];
    firstname?: string;
    lastname?: string;
    photo_guid?: string;
    member_id?: integer;
    [key: string]: any;
  }>;
  count?: integer;
  blocks?: Record<string, any>[];
  daily_limit_reached?: boolean;
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "emails": {
    "3100001": {
      "emails": [
        "parent@example.org",
        "guardian@example.org"
      ],
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "member_id": 3100001
    }
  },
  "count": 2,
  "blocks": [],
  "daily_limit_reached": false
}
```

### POST /ext/members/email/

**Resolve recipient emails or send an email**

Two `action` values share this POST endpoint:

**`getSelectedEmailsFromContacts`** (`sectionid` in the query string) —
resolves the addresses for a chosen set of members and contact groups.
Body fields:

| Field | Format | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `scouts` | comma-separated member IDs | e.g. `3100001,3100002` |
| `contactGroups` | JSON array of contact group identifiers | e.g. `["contact_primary_1","contact_primary_2","contact_primary_member"]` |

The response is the same shape as the GET form (keyed by member ID).
`count` is the number of addresses, not members.

**`sendTemplate`** — sends (or schedules) an email. `emails` is the JSON
object returned by `getSelectedEmailsFromContacts` (optionally with an
`order` per member); `edits` is a JSON object of template regions
`{ regionId: { blockIndex: { "text": "<html>" } } }`. For a plain email
the region ID is `"0"`; when a campaign template is used, the region IDs
are the campaign's `snippet_id`s (see
`/v3/members/email/campaigns/snippets/{campaignId}`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getSelectedEmailsFromContacts" \| "sendTemplate"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (required for `getSelectedEmailsFromContacts`). |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  scouts?: string;  // `getSelectedEmailsFromContacts` — comma-separated member IDs.
  contactGroups?: string;  // `getSelectedEmailsFromContacts` — JSON array of contact group identifiers.
  subject?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — email subject.
  from?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — sender, formatted `Display Name <address>`.
  cc?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — CC addresses (may be empty).
  save_email_from?: "true" | "false";  // `sendTemplate` — remember `from` as the default sender.
  emails?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — JSON object of recipients keyed by member ID.
  edits?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — JSON object of template region content.
  sectionid?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — section ID.
  current_section_id?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — section the user is currently viewing.
  campaign_id?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — campaign template ID, or `0` for a plain email.
  email_session_key?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — observed `blank`.
  guid?: string /* uuid */;  // `sendTemplate` — draft GUID (ties attachments to the email).
  draft_email_id?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — ID returned by `POST /v3/members/email/draft`.
  scheduled_email_id?: string;  // `sendTemplate` — scheduled email being sent, or `0`.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Resolve recipient emails (action=getSelectedEmailsFromContacts):

```json
{
  "scouts": "3100001,3100002",
  "contactGroups": "[\"contact_primary_1\",\"contact_primary_2\",\"contact_primary_member\"]"
}
```

Example — Send an email (action=sendTemplate):

```json
{
  "cc": "",
  "from": "1st Riverside Cubs <cubs@example.org>",
  "save_email_from": "false",
  "subject": "Weekly Meeting Reminder",
  "emails": "{\"3100001\":{\"firstname\":\"Jamie\",\"lastname\":\"River\",\"member_id\":3100001,\"order\":0,\"photo_guid\":\"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000\",\"emails\":[\"parent@example.org\"]}}",
  "edits": "{\"0\":{\"0\":{\"text\":\"<p>Don't forget to bring your swimming kit this week!</p>\"}}}",
  "sectionid": "45002",
  "current_section_id": "45002",
  "campaign_id": "0",
  "email_session_key": "blank",
  "guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  "draft_email_id": "80000001",
  "scheduled_email_id": "0"
}
```

**Response 200** — Selected emails (`getSelectedEmailsFromContacts`) or send confirmation (`sendTemplate`).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  emails?: Record<string, {
    emails?: string[];
    firstname?: string;
    lastname?: string;
    photo_guid?: string;
    member_id?: integer;
    [key: string]: any;
  }>;
  count?: integer;
  blocks?: Record<string, any>[];
  daily_limit_reached?: boolean;
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  ok: boolean;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Email sent:

```json
{
  "ok": true
}
```

### GET /ext/settings/emails/

**Get email configuration or delivery reports for a section**

- `getConfig` — the email/newsletter configuration for a section,
  including available events and patrols that can be used as recipient
  filters when composing emails. Also indicates whether the section has
  a newsletter slug configured and if it is live.
- `getDeliveryReport` — the section's sent (and, with
  `include_scheduled=true`, scheduled) emails. The response is a **bare
  array**: the first element is an `ALL` summary row
  (`{id: "0", name: "ALL", type: "all", count}`), followed by one row per
  email with send status, recipient/error/open counts and tracked links.
- `getDeliveryReportRows` — per-recipient delivery status for one email
  (`email_id`). `status` is the display status (`sent`, `opened`, …) and
  `status_raw` the provider status (`delivered`, `open`, …).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getConfig" \| "getDeliveryReport" \| "getDeliveryReportRows"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`getConfig`, `getDeliveryReport`). |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`getDeliveryReportRows`). |
| `email_id` | query | no | `string` | Email ID from `getDeliveryReport` (required for `getDeliveryReportRows`). |
| `generic_date` | query | no | `"true"` | `getDeliveryReport` — return `date` as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss`. |
| `include_scheduled` | query | no | `"true"` | `getDeliveryReport` — include scheduled (not yet sent) emails. |

**Response 200** — Email configuration, delivery report, or delivery report rows.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  found?: boolean;
  result?: {
    sectionid?: string;
    slug?: string;  // Newsletter slug for the section.
    numemails?: string;  // Number of emails sent (as string).
    live?: "0" | "1";  // Whether the newsletter is live.
  };
  events?: {
    name?: string;
    slug?: string;
  }[];  // Upcoming events that can be used as email filters.
  patrols?: {
    name?: string;
    slug?: string;
  }[];  // Patrols/sixes in the section.
  leaders?: boolean;  // Whether leaders are available as recipients.
  [key: string]: any;
} | Record<string, any>[] | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Email configuration (action=getConfig):

```json
{
  "found": true,
  "result": {
    "sectionid": "45001",
    "slug": "1stRiversideCubs",
    "numemails": "0",
    "live": "1"
  },
  "events": [
    {
      "name": "Summer Camp 2025",
      "slug": "SummerCamp2025"
    },
    {
      "name": "Investiture Ceremony",
      "slug": "InvestitureCeremony"
    }
  ],
  "patrols": [
    {
      "name": "Blue",
      "slug": "Blue"
    },
    {
      "name": "Green",
      "slug": "Green"
    }
  ],
  "leaders": true
}
```

Example — Delivery report (action=getDeliveryReport):

```json
[
  {
    "id": "0",
    "name": "ALL",
    "type": "all",
    "count": 1
  },
  {
    "id": 80000001,
    "type": "email",
    "date": "2025-01-10 13:05:00",
    "subject": "Weekly Meeting Reminder",
    "status": "SENT",
    "sent": 2,
    "errors": 0,
    "warnings": 0,
    "opens": 1,
    "hascontent": true,
    "config": null,
    "scheduled_recipient_count": 0,
    "failure_reason": null,
    "from_email": "cubs@example.org",
    "has_attachments": false,
    "links": [
      {
        "url": "https://www.example.org/kit-list",
        "click_count": 0,
        "last_clicked": null
      }
    ],
    "user_id": 100001,
    "photo_url": false,
    "from_name": "Alex Scout"
  }
]
```

Example — Per-recipient status (action=getDeliveryReportRows):

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "emailid": "80000001",
      "sendtime": "10/01/2025 13:05",
      "subject": "Weekly Meeting Reminder",
      "email": "parent@example.org",
      "status": "opened",
      "lastupdated": "10/01/2025 17:46",
      "member_id": "3100001",
      "hascontent": true,
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "status_raw": "open",
      "id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
      "email_key": "parentexampleorg"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "ids": [
      "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "has_attachments": false,
    "can_be_forwarded_status": "empty",
    "itemstore": {
      "identifier": "id"
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /ext/members/email/campaigns/

**List email campaign templates**

Saved campaign (newsletter) templates. `campaign_preview` is a relative
URL to an HTML preview. Load a campaign's content with
`/v3/members/email/campaigns/snippets/{campaignId}`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"listCampaigns"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Campaigns.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "campaign_id": 70001,
      "title": "Termly Newsletter",
      "template": "turquoise",
      "created_at": "2024-12-19 21:10:35",
      "last_used": "2024-12-20 20:46:18",
      "updated_at": "2024-12-19 21:10:42",

      "has_scheduled_email": false
    }
  ],
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/members/email/campaigns/snippets/{campaignId}

**Get a campaign's content snippets**

The ordered content blocks (`snippets`) of a campaign template, the
HTML `snippet_templates` used to render each block type
(`fullwidth_text`, `text_text`, `splitter`), and the template's `body`
and `style`. When sending, each `snippet_id` becomes a region key in
`sendTemplate`'s `edits`. Fetching a campaign for editing is preceded
by `POST /ext/generic/locks/?action=obtain` with `item=campaign_<id>`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `campaignId` | path | yes | `string` | Campaign ID. |

**Response 200** — Campaign snippets.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "snippets": [
      {
        "snippet_id": 300001,
        "snippet": "fullwidth_text",
        "contents": [
          {
            "text": "<h1>Termly Newsletter</h1>"
          }
        ],
        "config": null,
        "order": 1
      }
    ],
    "snippet_templates": {
      "fullwidth_text": "<tr id=\"s___snippet_id[0]\">…</tr>",
      "text_text": "__css__\n<tr id=\"s___snippet_id[0]\">…</tr>",
      "splitter": "<tr id=\"s___snippet_id[0]\">…</tr>"
    },
    "campaign_template": "turquoise",
    "body": "<div class=\"body\">…</div>",
    "style": ".template_editor_turquoise { … }"
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/members/email/draft/{sectionid}

The current user's draft emails for the section. `edits` is the decoded
region array (the same structure sent to `sendTemplate`).
`meta.template_count` is the number of saved campaigns.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Response 200** — Drafts.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "emailid": 80000001,
      "guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      "status": "DRAFT",
      "sectionid": 45002,
      "emailtype": "MANUAL",
      "subject": "",
      "sendtime": "2025-09-22 20:52:04",
      "content": null,
      "edits": [
        [
          {
            "text": "<p>Draft text</p>"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "campaign_id": 0,
      "to": null,
      "user_id": 100001,
      "from_email": "",
      "full_from_email": "",
      "config": null
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "template_count": 3
  }
}
```

### POST /v3/members/email/draft

**Save a draft email**

Autosaves the email being composed. Called repeatedly while editing;
the `guid` identifies the draft so repeated saves update the same
record. Returns the draft's ID, which is then passed to `sendTemplate`
as `draft_email_id`.

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  subject?: string;
  guid?: string /* uuid */;
  section_id?: string;
  campaign_id?: string;
  edits?: string;  // JSON object of template regions (see `sendTemplate`).
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "subject": "Weekly Meeting Reminder",
  "guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  "section_id": "45002",
  "campaign_id": "0",
  "edits": "{\"0\":{\"0\":{\"text\":\"<p>Draft text</p>\"}}}"
}
```

**Response 200** — Draft saved.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "id": 80000001
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

# OSM API — Programme

Programme summaries, meetings, and attachments.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/programme/` — Programme endpoints
- `POST /ext/programme/` — Update programme meeting parts
- `GET /ext/programme/activities/` — Activity library
- `GET /v3/programme/{eveningId}/bookings` — Get meeting with parent bookings
- `GET /v3/todo/projects/{sectionId}` — List to-do projects
- `GET /v3/todo/tasks/meeting/{eveningId}` — Get to-do tasks for a meeting
- `GET /ext/recipes/` — List recipes

### GET /ext/programme/

**Programme endpoints**

Programme endpoints share this path with different `action` values.
Use `getProgrammeSummary` for term overview, `getProgramme` for details,
`getMembersForParentRota` for parent rota members, or
`programmeAttachmentsManifest` for attachment metadata.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getProgrammeSummary" \| "getProgramme" \| "programmeAttachmentsManifest" \| "getMembersForParentRota"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | no | `string` | Term ID. |
| `eveningid` | query | no | `string` | Meeting ID. |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID. |
| `id` | query | no | `string` | Meeting ID. |
| `evening_id` | query | no | `string` | Meeting ID. |
| `verbose` | query | no | `string` | Set to `1` to add `badges` and `unavailable_leaders` to each summary item. |
| `path` | query | no | `string` | `programmeAttachmentsManifest` — directory within the manifest (observed `/`). |
| `temp` | query | no | `string` | `programmeAttachmentsManifest` — include uncommitted uploads (observed `false`). |
| `upload_mode` | query | no | `string` | `programmeAttachmentsManifest` — observed `programme`. |

**Response 200** — Programme response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  items?: {
    eveningid?: string;  // Meeting ID.
    sectionid?: string;
    title?: string;
    notesforparents?: string;  // Notes shown to parents in the parent portal.
    notesforhelpingparents?: string | null;  // Notes for parents on the helper rota.
    parentsrequired?: string;  // Number of parent helpers needed, as a string.
    prenotes?: string;  // Leader notes for the start of the meeting.
    games?: string;  // Leader notes for games.
    postnotes?: string;  // Leader notes for the end of the meeting.
    leaders?: string;  // Free text, typically the leaders running the meeting.
    meetingdate?: string /* date */;
    starttime?: string;
    endtime?: string;
    primary_leader_id?: string;  // ID of the leader in charge.
    config?: {
      has_badges?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
    soft_deleted?: string;  // "1" if the meeting has been deleted.
    help?: Record<string, any>[];  // Parent helpers. Items include `scoutid` and `scout` (full name).
    unavailableleaders?: Record<string, any>[];
    activities?: Record<string, any>[];
    badgelinks?: Record<string, any>[];  // Empty array when there are no links (PHP empty map).
    seasonal_suggestions?: Record<string, any>[];  // Activity ideas from OSM's shared activity library.
    [key: string]: any;
  }[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: Record<string, any>[];
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Programme summary:

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "eveningid": "9500001",
      "title": "Camp Skills Night",
      "parentsrequired": "1",
      "meetingdate": "2024-11-01",
      "parentsattendingcount": "0",
      "primary_leader": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Programme summary with verbose=1:

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "eveningid": "9500001",
      "title": "Camp Skills Night",
      "parentsrequired": "0",
      "meetingdate": "2024-11-01",
```

### POST /ext/programme/

**Update programme meeting parts**

Fields left out of `parts` are unchanged. Unlike `getProgramme`, the
response is a flat object with no `items` wrapper or `status`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"editEveningParts"` |  |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  sectionid: string;
  eveningid: string;
  parts: string;  // JSON-encoded object of `ProgrammeMeeting` fields to change. Observed: `title`, `prenotes`, `games`, `postnotes`, `notesforparents`.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Rename a meeting:

```json
{
  "sectionid": "12345",
  "eveningid": "9464403",
  "parts": "{\"title\":\"Astronomy Night 2\"}"
}
```

Example — Clear the notes for parents:

```json
{
  "sectionid": "12345",
  "eveningid": "9464403",
  "parts": "{\"notesforparents\":\"\"}"
}
```

**Response 200** — The full meeting after the update.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  eveningid?: string;  // Meeting ID.
  sectionid?: string;
  title?: string;
  notesforparents?: string;  // Notes shown to parents in the parent portal.
  notesforhelpingparents?: string | null;  // Notes for parents on the helper rota.
  parentsrequired?: string;  // Number of parent helpers needed, as a string.
  prenotes?: string;  // Leader notes for the start of the meeting.
  games?: string;  // Leader notes for games.
  postnotes?: string;  // Leader notes for the end of the meeting.
  leaders?: string;  // Free text, typically the leaders running the meeting.
  meetingdate?: string /* date */;
  starttime?: string;
  endtime?: string;
  primary_leader_id?: string;  // ID of the leader in charge.
  config?: {
    has_badges?: boolean;
    [key: string]: any;
  };
  soft_deleted?: string;  // "1" if the meeting has been deleted.
  help?: Record<string, any>[];  // Parent helpers. Items include `scoutid` and `scout` (full name).
  unavailableleaders?: Record<string, any>[];
  activities?: Record<string, any>[];
  badgelinks?: Record<string, any>[];  // Empty array when there are no links (PHP empty map).
  seasonal_suggestions?: Record<string, any>[];  // Activity ideas from OSM's shared activity library.
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "eveningid": "9464403",
  "sectionid": "12345",
  "title": "Astronomy Night",
  "notesforparents": "Bring a torch.",
```

### GET /ext/programme/activities/

**Activity library**

OSM's shared activity library.

- `getActivity` — one activity (`id` + `version`) with its full
  details, attached `files`, available `versions`, suitable `sections`,
  and whether the current user owns it.
- `searchByNewActivities` — the newest shared activities (up to 100
  `items`; `num` is the total, `query` echoes `newest activities`).
- `getTags` — every activity tag in use OSM-wide (a very large list —
  over ten thousand entries).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getActivity" \| "searchByNewActivities" \| "getTags"` |  |
| `id` | query | no | `string` | Activity ID (`getActivity`). |
| `version` | query | no | `string` | Activity version (`getActivity`). |
| `activity_unique_id` | query | no | `string` | `getActivity` — observed `0`. |
| `section` | query | no | `string` | Section type. |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`getActivity`). |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (`searchByNewActivities`). |

**Response 200** — Activity, search results, or tags.

`application/json`:

```ts
Record<string, any>
```

Example — One activity (action=getActivity):

```json
{
  "details": {
    "id": "500001",
```

### GET /ext/recipes/

**List recipes**

The recipe database (OSM-wide and the section's own). Each recipe has
meal/cooking-method tags, a `suitability` map of dietary flags (`true`
= suitable for that diet / free from that allergen), and an estimated
`my_cost_per_person` in pounds.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getRecipes"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Recipes.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "recipe_id": 5,
      "title": "Campfire Bananas",
      "description": "Easy dessert cooked in foil.",
      "cache": {
        "tags": {
          "meals": [
            "pudding"
          ],
          "cooking_methods": [
            "campfire"
          ]
        },
        "suitability": {
          "vegetarian": true,
          "vegan": false,
          "gluten": true,
          "dairy": false,
          "nuts": true,
          "wheat": true,
          "fish": true,
          "shellfish": true,
          "egg": true,
          "soya": true,
          "oatmeal": true
        }
      },
      "cooking_time": "20",
      "image_lastupdated": null,
      "last_updated": "2025-10-10 14:07:03",
      "image": "upload",
      "original_recipe_id": "0",
      "tags": [
        "pudding",
        "campfire"
      ],
      "image_url": "/ext/recipes/thumbnails/?recipe_id=5",
      "review_summary": {
        "recipe": {
          "rating": 0,
          "number_reviews": 0
        }
      },
      "my_cost_per_person": 0.35
    }
  ],
  "meta": []
}
```
