# OSM API — Badges

Badge-related programme metadata.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/badges/records/` — Get badge records or available badges
- `GET /ext/badges/badgesbyperson/` — Load badges grouped by member
- `GET /ext/programme/clouds/` — Get badge tag cloud

### GET /ext/badges/records/

**Get badge records or available badges**

Returns badge data. The `action` parameter controls the behavior:
- `getBadgeRecords` — returns per-member completion records for a specific badge.
- `getAvailableBadges` — returns the list of badges available for a section and type.
  When called with `asNumericArray=y&liveOnly=y&addGroupToName=y` (as the
  attendance register does), the response is a Dojo item store
  (`identifier` / `label` / `items`) containing every live badge for the
  section across all types, and `type_id` / `term_id` are not needed.
  Either `sectionid` or `section_id` is accepted.
- `getColumnsForBadge` — returns the requirement columns (the individual
  criteria, grouped into lettered modules) for one badge version.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getBadgeRecords" \| "getAvailableBadges" \| "getColumnsForBadge"` |  |
| `section` | query | yes | `"squirrels" \| "beavers" \| "cubs" \| "scouts" \| "explorers"` | Section type. |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (used with `getAvailableBadges`). |
| `sectionid` | query | no | `string` | Section ID (alternate naming, used with some actions). |
| `term_id` | query | no | `string` | Term ID (not sent by the item-store form of `getAvailableBadges`). |
| `type_id` | query | no | `"1" \| "2" \| "3" \| "4"` | Badge type ID. 1 = Challenge, 2 = Activity, 3 = Staged, 4 = Core. Not sent by the item-store form of `getAvailableBadges`. |
| `asNumericArray` | query | no | `"y"` | `getAvailableBadges` — return `items` as a flat array. |
| `liveOnly` | query | no | `"y"` | `getAvailableBadges` — only include current (live) badge versions. |
| `addGroupToName` | query | no | `"y"` | `getAvailableBadges` — prefix `name` with the badge group where one is set. |
| `noHidden` | query | no | `"y"` | `getColumnsForBadge` — exclude hidden columns. |
| `editable` | query | no | `"y"` | `getColumnsForBadge` — only include columns that can be edited. |
| `badge_id` | query | no | `string` | Badge ID (required for `getBadgeRecords` and `getColumnsForBadge`). |
| `badge_version` | query | no | `string` | Badge version (required for `getBadgeRecords` and `getColumnsForBadge`). |
| `payload` | query | no | `"1"` | Include full payload (observed value `1`). |
| `context` | query | no | `"none"` | Context (observed value `none` for `getAvailableBadges`). |
| `member_id` | query | no | `string` | Member ID filter (observed value `0` for all members). |

**Response 200** — Badge records or available badges.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: Record<string, any>[];
  meta?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
} | {
  identifier?: string;
  label?: string;
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Available badges (asNumericArray=y&liveOnly=y&addGroupToName=y):

```json
{
  "identifier": "badge_identifier",
  "label": "name",
  "items": [
    {
```

# OSM API — Dashboard

Dashboard summaries and next things.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/dashboard/` — Get next things dashboard data

### GET /ext/dashboard/

**Get next things dashboard data**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getNextThings"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | yes | `string` | Term ID. |
| `section` | query | yes | `"squirrels" \| "beavers" \| "cubs" \| "scouts" \| "explorers" \| "adults"` | Section type. |
| `parts` | query | no | `"core" \| "agenda" \| "section_widgets" \| "user_widgets"` | Returns only one slice of the dashboard. The web UI now makes four requests, one per part; every response echoes `parts` back. Keys observed per part: \| `parts` \| Keys returned \| \|---------\|---------------\| \| `core` \| `is_full_admin`, `duplicate_admin_names`, `permissions` \| \| `agenda` \| `conf`, `patrols`, `birthdays`, `programme`, `events` \| \| `section_widgets` \| `notepad`, `subscription_expiring_soon`, `members`, `outstandingpayments`, `shop_orders_to_dispatch`, `badge_homework`, `deletable_members`, `due_badges`, `meetings_needing_badge_updates`, `pending_applicant_count`, `thanks` \| \| `user_widgets` \| `programme_reviews`, `badge_supplier_review_prompt`, `blocked_expense_card_transactions`, `chat_highlights`, `expense_cards`, `feature_request_voting`, `pending_expense_cardholder_application`, `recommendation`, `unanswered_question`, `user_to_do_tasks`, `whats_new` \| Omit `parts` to receive the combined response shown in the example. |

**Response 200** — Dashboard next things response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  conf?: Record<string, integer>;
  is_full_admin?: boolean;
  permissions?: Record<string, any>;
  patrols?: Record<string, any>[];
  birthdays?: Record<string, any>[];
  programme?: Record<string, any>[];
  events?: Record<string, any>[];
  outstandingpayments?: Record<string, any>[];
  surveys?: boolean | Record<string, any>;
  notepad?: Record<string, any>;
  subscription_expiring_soon?: boolean;
  programme_reviews?: Record<string, any>[];
  deletable_members?: Record<string, any>;
  due_badges?: Record<string, any>;
  expense_cards?: Record<string, any>;
  feature_request_voting?: Record<string, any>;
  pending_expense_cardholder_application?: Record<string, any>;
  thanks?: Record<string, any>;
  unanswered_question?: Record<string, any>;
  user_to_do_tasks?: Record<string, any>;
  whats_new?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{

    "birthdays": 1,
    "programme": 1,
    "events": 1
  },
```

# OSM API — Risk Assessments

Programme and meeting risk assessments.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /v3/risk_assessments/{sectionId}/categories` — Show programme risk assessment categories
- `GET /v3/risk_assessments/reviews/{sectionId}` — List risk assessment review status
- `GET /ext/risk_assessments/` — Get a risk assessment

### GET /v3/risk_assessments/{sectionId}/categories

**Show programme risk assessment categories**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionId` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Response 200** — Risk assessment categories response.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: any | null;
  data?: Record<string, any>[];
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "name": "General Risks"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "itemstore": {
      "identifier": "name"
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /v3/risk_assessments/reviews/{sectionId}

**List risk assessment review status**

Review schedule for the section's risk assessments. Each entry gives
when it was last reviewed and by whom, `next_review_on`,
`days_until_due` (negative when overdue) and `status` (observed
`overdue`). `type` is the kind of thing assessed (observed `programme`)
and `associated_id` its ID. `is_implicit` appears to mark entries OSM
created automatically. `meta.review_months` is the review interval.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionId` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Response 200** — Review entries.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "reviewed_on": "2025-09-10",
      "reviewed_by_name": "Alex Leader",
      "next_review_on": "2026-09-10",
      "status": "overdue",
      "days_until_due": -61,
      "is_implicit": false,
      "type": "programme",
      "associated_id": 45001,
      "title": "General meeting risk assessment",
      "last_used_on": "2026-11-03"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "review_months": 12
  }
}
```

### GET /ext/risk_assessments/

**Get a risk assessment**

The hazards recorded against a meeting, activity, or event. `data` is
an array of hazards (a Dojo item store: `meta.itemstore` gives the
identifier `hazard_id` and label `hazard`). For `activity` and
`generic_event` assessments, `meta` also carries `review` (last review,
or `null`) and `review_months` (review interval, observed `12`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getRiskAssessment"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `type` | query | yes | `string` | What the assessment is attached to. Observed: `meeting`, `activity`, `generic_event`. |
| `associated_id` | query | yes | `string` | ID of the meeting / activity / event. Observed `0` with `type=generic_event` (the section's generic event assessment). |

**Response 200** — Hazards.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": {
    "itemstore": {
      "identifier": "hazard_id",
      "label": "hazard"
    },
    "review": null,
    "review_months": 12
  }
}
```

# OSM API — Events

Events, event attendance and payments, Parent Portal settings, and kit lists.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/events/summary/` — List events or the event audit log
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/basic_details` — Get event basic details
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/summary` — Get event summary
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/members/attendance` — Get event attendance
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/members/payments` — Get event payments
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/parent_portal` — Get event Parent Portal settings
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/timetable` — Get event timetable
- `GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/activities` — Get event "at home" activities
- `GET /v3/kit/{sectionid}/event` — Get kit list items and collections
- `POST /v3/kit/{sectionid}/event/{collectionId}` — Update a kit list collection

### GET /ext/events/summary/

**List events or the event audit log**

- `get` — events for the term with headline attendance counts
  (`yes` = total attending, split into `yes_members` / `yes_yls` /
  `yes_leaders`; plus `no`, `invited`, `reserved`, `shown`). Dates come
  in both UK (`dd/mm/yyyy`) and ISO (`startdate_g`) forms. `cost` is a
  decimal string in pounds.
- `getEvents` — a lightweight list (`eventid`, `name`, `startdate`,
  `attachments`). With `onlyArchived=1`, returns archived events only.
- `getAudit` — recent attendance changes made by parents through the
  Parent Portal (`type=portal`), newest first.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"get" \| "getEvents" \| "getAudit"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `termid` | query | no | `string` | Term ID (`get`, `getEvents`). |
| `onlyArchived` | query | no | `"1"` | `getEvents` — only return archived events. |
| `type` | query | no | `"portal"` | `getAudit` — audit source (observed `portal`). |

**Response 200** — Dojo item store of events or audit entries.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  identifier?: string;
  label?: string;
  items?: Record<string, any>[];
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Events with attendance counts (action=get):

```json
{
  "identifier": "eventid",
  "items": [
    {
      "eventid": "1700001",
      "name": "Winter Sleepover",
      "date": "06/12/2025",
      "startdate_g": "2025-12-06",
      "startdate": "06/12/2025",
      "enddate": "07/12/2025",
      "starttime": "11:00:00",
      "endtime": "14:00:00",
      "cost": "40.00",
      "location": "Riverside Scout Hut",
      "approval_status": null,
      "rota_offered": 0,
      "rota_accepted": 0,
      "rota_required": null,
      "yes": 18,
      "yes_members": 15,
      "yes_yls": 0,
      "yes_leaders": 3,
      "reserved": 0,
      "no": 2,
      "absent": 0,
      "invited": 4,
      "shown": 0,
      "x": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Archived events (action=getEvents&onlyArchived=1):

```json
{
  "identifier": "eventid",
  "label": "name",
  "items": [
    {
      "eventid": "1700002",
      "name": "District Camp",
      "startdate": "2024-06-19",
      "attachments": false
    }
  ]
}
```

Example — Parent Portal changes (action=getAudit&type=portal):

```json
{
  "identifier": "auditid",
  "items": [
    {
      "auditid": "50000001",
      "eventid": "1700001",
      "name": "Winter Sleepover",
      "firstname": "Jamie",
      "lastname": "River",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "member_id": "3100001",
      "updatedate": "2025-11-07 13:16:11",
      "date": "07/11/2025 13:16",
      "generic_date": "2025-11-07 13:16:11",
      "updatedby": "Jamie",
      "type": "attendance",
      "desc": "Attendance: Yes"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/basic_details

**Get event basic details**

Name, location, dates/times, cost (number, in **pounds**), and
attendance limit. `meta` reports lock state (`past_locked`,
`shared_locked`) and whether the event is on the Parent Portal.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | path | yes | `string` | Event ID. |

**Response 200** — Event basic details.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "name": "Winter Sleepover",
    "location": "Riverside Scout Hut",
    "start_date": "2025-12-06",
    "start_time": "11:00:00",
    "end_date": "2025-12-07",
    "end_time": "14:00:00",
    "cost": 40,
    "attendance_limit": 24,
    "attendance_limit_includes_leaders": false,
    "extra": {
      "at_home": {
        "enabled": false,

        "parent_uploads_enabled": false,
        "chat_enabled": false,
        "activities": []
      },

        "sharee": false,
        "deleted": false
      }

    "properties": []
  },

    "read_only": false,
    "past_locked": false,
    "shared_locked": false,
    "maximum_attendance_limit": 0,
    "has_parent_portal": true
  }
}
```

### GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/summary

**Get event summary**

The event overview page. `data` holds the attending members, online
payment totals, linked finance totals, "at home" activity counts and
risk-assessment counts. `meta.event` is the full event record including
**every invited member with their date of birth**, payment schedule
(`payment_dates`) and kit list collection — treat as sensitive.

Money units differ within this response: `cost` is in pounds, while
`online_payments.received` / `expected` are also in pounds (expected =
attendees × cost).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | path | yes | `string` | Event ID. |

**Response 200** — Event summary.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
```

### GET /v3/events/event/{eventId}/members/attendance

**Get event attendance**

One row per member in the section with their invitation/attendance
state. `attending` is lowercase (`yes`, `no`, `invited`, or empty for
not invited). `age_at_start` is `years / months`, or `25+` for adults.
`meta.structure` lists any custom event columns.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | path | yes | `string` | Event ID. |
| `term_id` | query | yes | `string` | Term ID. |

**Response 200** — Event attendance.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "member_id": 3100001,
      "patrol_id": 12001,
      "first_name": "Jamie",
      "last_name": "River",
      "_filterString": "jamie river",
      "photo_guid": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "attending": "yes",
      "emailable": true,
      "details": [],
      "age_at_start": "10 / 07"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "maximum_attendance_limit": 0,
    "has_parent_portal": true,
    "can_set_absent": false,
    "structure": [],
    "rota_accepted": 0,
    "structure_read_only": false,
    "attendance_read_only": false,
    "columns_read_only": false,
    "approval_locked": false,
    "shared_deadline_locked": false,
    "approval_status": null
  }
}
```

### GET /v3/kit/{sectionid}/event

```ts
}
```

```json
  "error": null,

    {
      "id": 39,
      "associated_type": "event",

      "name": "Bike",
      "description": "Check brakes and gears work.",
      "purchase_link": "",
      "multiple": false,

        "updated_at": "2023-09-27 20:59:35"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### POST /v3/kit/{sectionid}/event/{collectionId}

**Update a kit list collection**

Saves a kit list collection. `items` is a JSON array of
`{"item_id": <kit item id>, "quantity": <n>}` and **replaces** the
collection's contents.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `collectionId` | path | yes | `string` | Kit list collection ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  name?: string;
  instructions?: string;
  items?: string;  // JSON array of `{item_id, quantity}`.
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "name": "Sleepovers",
  "instructions": "Please label all kit.",
  "items": "[{\"item_id\":39,\"quantity\":1},{\"item_id\":40,\"quantity\":1}]"
}
```

**Response 200** — Collection saved.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": []
}
```


---

# OSM API — Finance

Accounting (cashbook, bank accounts, budgets, reports), expense cards,
and invoices.

**Units:** the `/v3/finances/accounting/` endpoints use **integer pence**
(`9706` = £97.06). Event endpoints (`/v3/events/…`, `/ext/events/…`)
use **pounds**.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/section/{sectionid}` — List financial years
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/year/{financialYearId}` — List cashbook transactions for a financial year
- `POST /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/section/{sectionid}` — Create a cashbook transaction
- `POST /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/{transactionId}` — Update a cashbook transaction
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/budgets/year/{financialYearId}` — Get budgets for a financial year
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/annual_report/{financialYearId}` — Get annual report
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/reports/overview/{sectionid}` — Get monthly finance overview
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/section/{sectionid}` — List bank accounts
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/{bankAccountId}/transactions` — List imported bank transactions
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_account_transactions/{bankAccountTransactionId}/guess_category` — Guess a category for a bank transaction
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/{bankAccountId}/trustees` — List expense account trustees
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/categories/section/{sectionid}` — List accounting categories
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/{sectionid}/existing_group_accounts` — List the group's existing accounts
- `GET /v3/comments/accounting/{sectionid}/list` — List accounting comments
- `GET /ext/finances/onlinepayments/` — Get Online Payments schemes
- `GET /ext/finances/onlinepayments/merchants/` — Get Online Payments merchant summary
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/expense_cardholders/section/{sectionid}` — List expense cardholders
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/items/section/{sectionid}` — List tracked finance items
- `GET /v3/finances/accounting/items/links/event/{eventId}` — List cashbook lines linked to an event
- `GET /ext/finances/invoices/summary/` — List invoices

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/section/{sectionid}

**List financial years**

The section's financial years, newest first, each with income/expense
totals. Use the `id` with the cashbook, budget and annual report
endpoints. **All accounting amounts are integers in pence.**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Response 200** — Financial years.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 7002,
      "section_id": 45003,
      "start_date": "2025-04-06",
      "end_date": "2026-04-05",
      "created_at": "2025-04-06 09:00:00",
      "updated_at": "2025-04-06 09:00:00",
      "title": "2025 - 2026",
      "transaction_summary": {
        "total_income": 250000,
        "total_expense": 180000
      }
    }
  ],
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/year/{financialYearId}

**List cashbook transactions for a financial year**

Paginated cashbook. Each transaction carries its category split
(`categories[]`, each with an `amount` and the resolved `category`),
and is linked to the imported bank line via `bank_account_transaction_id`.
`meta` includes year totals, the full category list
(`categories`), the categories used this year
(`categories_in_financial_year`), and tracked `items`.

Amounts are in **pence**. Payment-provider payouts are typically split
into an income category plus a `Bank Fees` expense category, so
`categories[].amount` may not sum to the headline `amount`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `financialYearId` | path | yes | `string` | Financial year ID. |
| `page` | query | no | `integer` |  |
| `per_page` | query | no | `integer` |  |

**Response 200** — Cashbook page.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 800001,
      "incrementing_id": 101,
      "section_id": 45003,
      "date": "2025-10-08",
      "description": "PAYOUT REF EXAMPLE-0001",
      "description_sanitised": "PAYOUT REF EXAMPLE",
      "bank_account_reference_sanitised": "PAYOUT REF EXAMPLE",
      "bank_account_transaction_id": 900001,
      "type": "income",
      "amount": 9706,
      "locked": false,
      "categorised": 9706,
      "number_categories": 2,
      "auto_categorisation": "no guess",
      "created_at": "2025-10-10 16:24:16",
      "updated_at": "2025-10-10 16:24:16",
      "categories": [
        {
          "id": 810001,
          "category_id": 3,
          "item_id": 0,
          "transaction_id": 800001,
          "amount": 10000,
          "category": {
            "id": 3,
            "section_id": 0,
            "name": "Membership Fees",
            "type": "income",
            "icon": "membership"
          },
          "item": null
        },
        {
          "id": 810002,
          "category_id": 30,
          "item_id": 0,
          "transaction_id": 800001,
          "amount": 294,
          "category": {
            "id": 30,
            "section_id": 0,
            "name": "Bank Fees",
            "type": "expense",
            "icon": "bank"
          },
          "item": null
        }
      ],
      "attachments": 0
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "number_transactions": 1,
    "total_expense": 294,
    "total_income": 10000,
    "total_amount": 0,
    "categories": [
      {
        "id": 55,
        "section_id": 0,
        "name": "Admin",
        "type": "expense",
        "icon": "administration",
        "usages": []
      }
    ],
    "categories_in_financial_year": [],
    "items": [],
    "financial_year": {
      "start_date": "2025-04-06",
      "end_date": "2026-04-05"
    }
  }
}
```

### POST /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/section/{sectionid}

**Create a cashbook transaction**

Creates a cashbook entry, usually from an imported bank line
(`bank_account_transaction_id`). `amount` is in **pence**. `categories`
is a JSON array splitting the amount across categories:

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `category_id` | Category ID (see the `categories` list in cashbook `meta`). |
| `item_id` | Tracked item, or `0`. |
| `amount` | Pence. |
| `description`, `payment_id`, `scheme_id`, `is_fee` | Present when the split comes from an online payment payout. |

`attachments_id` is a client-generated GUID used to upload receipts via
the cashbook uploads manifest before the transaction exists.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  description: string;
  type: "income" | "expense";
  date: string /* date */;
  amount: integer;  // Pence.
  categories: string;  // JSON array of category splits.
  attachments_id?: string /* uuid */;
  bank_account_transaction_id?: string;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "description": "PAYOUT REF EXAMPLE-0002",
  "type": "income",
  "date": "2025-04-29",
  "amount": 2411,
  "categories": "[{\"category_id\":3,\"item_id\":0,\"amount\":2500},{\"category_id\":30,\"item_id\":0,\"amount\":89,\"is_fee\":true}]",
  "attachments_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
  "bank_account_transaction_id": "900002"
}
```

**Response 200** — Created transaction, with the category OSM would have guessed.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "id": 800002,
    "guessed_category_id": 3,
    "guessed_item_id": 0
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

### POST /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/{transactionId}

**Update a cashbook transaction**

Same body as create. When editing existing splits, each entry in
`categories` includes its `id` (and the other fields returned by the
cashbook list).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transactionId` | path | yes | `string` | Cashbook transaction ID. |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
Record<string, any>
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "description": "PAYOUT REF EXAMPLE-0001",
  "type": "income",
  "date": "2025-10-08",
  "amount": 9706,
  "categories": "[{\"id\":810001,\"category_id\":3,\"item_id\":0,\"amount\":10000},{\"id\":810002,\"category_id\":30,\"item_id\":0,\"amount\":294}]"
}
```

**Response 200** — Transaction updated.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/budgets/year/{financialYearId}

**Get budgets for a financial year**

Every category with its budgeted `amount` (pence) for the year.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `financialYearId` | path | yes | `string` | Financial year ID. |

**Response 200** — Budgets by category.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;

```

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 55,
      "section_id": 0,
      "name": "Admin",
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/financial_year/annual_report/{financialYearId}

**Get annual report**

Income and expense by category, balances per bank account, and a
summary (balance brought forward, carried forward, …) for the year,
optionally side-by-side with another year (`other_financial_year_id`,
`0` for none). Amounts in pence.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `financialYearId` | path | yes | `string` | Financial year ID. |
| `other_financial_year_id` | query | no | `string` | Comparison year ID, or `0`. |

**Response 200** — Annual report.

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/{bankAccountId}/transactions

**List imported bank transactions**

Imported bank statement lines for an account. `mode=unprocessed`
returns lines not yet turned into cashbook entries. `meta` carries the
category and item lists for categorising them.

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `mode` | query | no | `string` | Observed `unprocessed`. |
| `expense_cardholder_id` | query | no | `string` | Filter to one expense cardholder, or `0` for all. |
| `page` | query | no | `integer` |  |
| `per_page` | query | no | `integer` |  |

**Response 200** — Bank transactions.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_account_transactions/{bankAccountTransactionId}/guess_category

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;

  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "category_id": 33,
    "item_id": 0,
    "payout_details": [],
    "next_bank_transaction": {
      "id": 900003,
      "bank_account_id": 5001,
      "card_id": 0,
      "cardholder_id": 0,
      "transaction_id": 0,
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/{bankAccountId}/trustees

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/categories/section/{sectionid}

**List accounting categories**

Income and expense categories used to classify cashbook transactions
and budget lines. Each has a `type` (`income` or `expense`) and an
`icon` name. Soft-deleted categories carry a `deleted_at` timestamp;
`meta.has_deleted_categories` says whether any exist.

`application/json`:

```ts
  status?: boolean;

  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 81001,
      "section_id": 45001,
      "name": "Activities",
      "type": "expense",
      "icon": "activity",
      "created_at": "2023-09-01 19:00:00",
      "updated_at": "2023-09-01 19:00:00",
      "deleted_at": null,
      "visibilities": []

      "id": 81002,
      "section_id": 45001,

  "meta": {
    "has_deleted_categories": false
  }
```

### GET /v3/comments/accounting/{sectionid}/list

**List accounting comments**

Comment thread for the section's accounts. `meta` holds the current
user's comment permissions (`can_add`, `can_edit_self`,
`can_delete_others`, …) and `notification_topics`, keyed by topic
(e.g. `comments/accounting/45001`), which describes how the client
opens the thread from a notification. The path segment is the section
ID, but `section_id` is also required in the query string. Only an
empty `data` list has been observed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Comments and permissions.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": {
    "can_edit_self": true,
    "can_edit_others": false,
    "can_delete_self": true,
    "can_delete_others": false,
    "can_add": true,
    "notification_topics": {
      "comments/accounting/45001": {
        "label": "Accounts",
        "section_id": 45001,
        "permission_type": "finance",
        "permission_value": "10",
        "specified_section_id": 45001,
        "javascript_data": {
          "require": "accounting",
          "execute": "open",
          "args": [
            "comments"
          ],
          "params": {
            "id": "45001",
            "react": "Accounting",
            "props": {
              "selected_tab": "comments"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "has_uploads": false
  }
}
```

### GET /ext/finances/onlinepayments/

**Get Online Payments schemes**

Online Payments schemes for the section, with the linked
`bank_accounts` and a `config` block describing the section's
subscription (`subscription_level`, `subscription_active`, expiry
dates) and paid add-ons (`portal`, `portalExpires`). `items` is empty
when no schemes are set up; populated items have not been observed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"getSchemes"` |  |
| `sectionid` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Schemes and subscription config.

`application/json`:

```ts
Record<string, any>
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "identifier": "schemeid",
  "label": "Payment schemes",
  "has_accounts": false,
  "items": [],
  "bank_accounts": [],
  "config": {
    "subscription_level": 3,
    "subscription_expires": "2026-09-01",
    "sectionType": "cubs",
    "section_type": "cubs",
    "parentSectionId": "44001",
    "hierarchy_lowest_level": true,
    "hierarchy_operating_level": "section",
    "config_subscriptions_checked": "2026-11-01 09:00:00",
    "subscription_active": true,
    "has_expense_account": true,
    "portal": {
      "expense_cards_fees": 1,
      "accounts": 1,
      "filestorage": 1
    },
    "portalExpires": {
      "accountsA": 1,
      "accounts": "2026-09-01",
      "filestorage": "2026-09-01",
      "filestorageA": 1
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /v3/finances/accounting/items/section/{sectionid}

---

# OSM API — Files

Several features share a common file-attachment API. Each exposes a
`manifest` action (sometimes namespaced, e.g. `emailerAttachmentsManifest`
or `programmeAttachmentsManifest`) on its own URL, taking `id`, `path`
(usually `/`), `section_id`, `temp`, plus a feature-specific ID.

The response's `data.config.endpoints` tells you the `action` names to
use on the same URL for each file operation (`put`, `get`, `preview`,
`rename`, `delete`, `putTemp`/`commitTemp`/`revertTemp` for staged
uploads, `partPut` for chunked uploads); an operation is `false` where
it is not allowed. `config` also gives allowed extensions/MIME types and
size limits, and `meta.size` the remaining quota.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `GET /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/` — Cashbook receipt attachments manifest
- `POST /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/` — Cashbook receipt attachments manifest (POST)
- `GET /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/index.php` — Preview a cashbook receipt
- `GET /ext/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/uploads/` — Bank account attachments manifest
- `GET /ext/programme/activities/attachments/files/` — Activity attachments manifest
- `GET /ext/mymember/programme/leader_resources/` — Meeting leader-resources manifest
- `GET /ext/mymember/events/leader_resources/` — Event leader-resources manifest
- `GET /ext/risk_assessments/uploads/` — Risk assessment attachments manifest

### GET /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/

**Cashbook receipt attachments manifest**

File manifest for receipts attached to a cashbook transaction. With
`temp=true`, `id` is the client-generated `attachments_id` GUID used
before the transaction is created. See [Files](#tag/Files).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"manifest"` |  |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Transaction ID, or the `attachments_id` GUID when `temp=true`. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |  |
| `temp` | query | no | `"true" \| "false"` |  |
| `bank_account_transaction_id` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — File manifest (see the Files tag for the shape).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "manifest": [],
    "config": {
      "endpoints": {
        "put": "put",
        "get": "get",
        "preview": "preview",
        "rename": "rename",
        "move": "move",
        "delete": "delete",
        "createDirectory": "createDirectory",
        "getDirectory": "getDirectory",
        "renameDirectory": "renameDirectory",
        "moveDirectory": "moveDirectory",
        "deleteDirectory": "deleteDirectory",
        "putTemp": "putTemp",
        "commitTemp": "commitTemp",
        "revertTemp": "revertTemp",
        "partPut": "partPut"
      },
      "can_delete_own_files": false,
      "allowed_extensions": [
        "pdf",
        "bmp",
        "… 3 more"
      ],
      "allowed_mime": [
        "application/pdf",
        "image/*"
      ],
      "max_file_size": 26214400,
      "max_file_size_human": "25.0 MB",
      "allow_empty": false,
      "single_file_size_limit": 10485760,
      "single_file_size_limit_human": "10.0 MB",
      "max_files": 10,
      "directory_limit": 1,
      "total_files_size_limit": 40789606,
      "total_files_size_limit_human": "38.9 MB",
      "upload_available_space": 10,
      "upload_limit": 10,
      "chunked_uploads": false,
      "preview_sizes": [
        "dialog"
      ]
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "size": {
      "remaining": 40789606,
      "remaining_human": "38.9 MB",
      "total": 40789606,
      "total_human": "38.9 MB"
    }
  }
}
```

### POST /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/

**Cashbook receipt attachments manifest (POST)**

The web client also fetches the cashbook manifest with a POST. All
parameters, including `action=manifest`, are in the query string and
there is no body. The response matches the GET form.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"manifest"` |  |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Transaction ID, or the `attachments_id` GUID when `temp=true`. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |  |
| `temp` | query | no | `"true" \| "false"` |  |
| `bank_account_transaction_id` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — File manifest (see the Files tag for the shape).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "manifest": [],
    "config": {
      "endpoints": {
        "put": "put",
        "get": "get",
        "preview": "preview",
        "rename": "rename",
        "move": "move",
        "delete": "delete",
        "createDirectory": "createDirectory",
        "getDirectory": "getDirectory",
        "renameDirectory": "renameDirectory",
        "moveDirectory": "moveDirectory",
        "deleteDirectory": "deleteDirectory",
        "putTemp": "putTemp",
        "commitTemp": "commitTemp",
        "revertTemp": "revertTemp",
        "partPut": "partPut"
      },
      "can_delete_own_files": false,
      "allowed_extensions": [
        "pdf",
        "bmp",
        "… 3 more"
      ],
      "allowed_mime": [
        "application/pdf",
        "image/*"
      ],
      "max_file_size": 26214400,
      "max_file_size_human": "25.0 MB",
      "allow_empty": false,
      "single_file_size_limit": 10485760,
      "single_file_size_limit_human": "10.0 MB",
      "max_files": 10,
      "directory_limit": 1,
      "total_files_size_limit": 40789606,
      "total_files_size_limit_human": "38.9 MB",
      "upload_available_space": 10,
      "upload_limit": 10,
      "chunked_uploads": false,
      "preview_sizes": [
        "dialog"
      ]
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "size": {
      "remaining": 40789606,
      "remaining_human": "38.9 MB",
      "total": 40789606,
      "total_human": "38.9 MB"
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /ext/finances/accounting/financial_year/cashbook/transactions/uploads/index.php

**Preview a cashbook receipt**

Image preview of an attached file, served as `image/png` (or the format
in `fm`). Use the `preview` URLs from the manifest
(`data.manifest[*].preview` / `preview_sizes`) as they are: `s` is a
server-generated signature over the other parameters, so changing
`w`, `h` or `fit` yourself will not work. Other features' `uploads/`
endpoints follow the same pattern.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"preview"` |  |
| `file` | query | yes | `string` | File path within the manifest. |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Transaction ID. |
| `bank_account_transaction_id` | query | no | `string` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `cb` | query | no | `string` | Cache-buster. |
| `_bypass_service_worker` | query | no | `"1"` |  |
| `fm` | query | no | `string` | Output format (observed `png`). |
| `fit` | query | no | `string` | Resize mode (observed `crop`). |
| `w` | query | no | `integer` |  |
| `h` | query | no | `integer` |  |
| `s` | query | yes | `string` | Signature generated by OSM; copy it from the manifest. |

**Response 200** — Preview image.

`image/png`:

```ts
string /* binary */
```

### GET /ext/finances/accounting/bank_accounts/uploads/

**Bank account attachments manifest**

File manifest for documents attached to a bank account (e.g.
statements). `manifest` is an empty array when there are no files.
See [Files](#tag/Files).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"manifest"` |  |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Bank account ID. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — File manifest (see the Files tag for the shape).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

```json
        "getDirectory": "getDirectory",

        "deleteDirectory": "deleteDirectory",
        "putTemp": "putTemp",
        "commitTemp": "commitTemp",
        "revertTemp": "revertTemp",
        "partPut": "partPut"
      },

      "allowed_extensions": [
        "pdf",
        "bmp",
        "… 3 more"
```

### GET /ext/programme/activities/attachments/files/

**Activity attachments manifest**

File manifest for an activity's attachments. Unlike other manifests,
this one is populated: each entry in `manifest` is keyed by path and
has the file's `mime`, `bytes`, human `size`, upload/access dates,
`access_count`, and `preview` URLs. See [Files](#tag/Files).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"manifest"` |  |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Activity ID. |
| `activity_id` | query | yes | `string` | Activity ID. |
| `activity_unique_id` | query | no | `string` | The activity version's unique ID (`details.id` from `getActivity`). |
| `section_id` | query | no | `string` | Observed `0`. |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |  |
| `temp` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Activity file manifest.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;
    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "manifest": {
      "/knot-relay.pdf": {
        "upload_id": 700001,
        "path": "/knot-relay.pdf",
        "directory": "/",
        "name": "knot-relay.pdf",
        "mime": "application/pdf",
        "extension": "pdf",
        "icon": "pdf",
        "bytes": 990000,
        "size": "967 KB",
        "lost": false,
        "temp": false,
        "date_uploaded": "08/10/2025 22:25",
        "date_last_accessed": "10/10/2025 16:52",
        "access_count": 13,
        "platform": "s3cache",
        "meta": [],
        "uploader_id": 0,
        "preview": "/ext/programme/activities/attachments/files/?action=preview&…",
        "preview_sizes": {
          "dialog": "/ext/programme/activities/attachments/files/?action=preview&size=dialog&…"
        },
        "props": []
      }
    },
    "config": {
      "endpoints": {
        "put": "put",
        "get": "get",
        "preview": "preview"
      },
      "single_file_size_limit_human": "5.0 MB",
      "directory_limit": 99,
      "chunked_uploads": false
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "size": {
      "remaining": false,
      "remaining_human": false,
      "total": false,
      "total_human": false
    }
  }
}
```

### GET /ext/mymember/programme/leader_resources/

**Meeting leader-resources manifest**

Portal for a meeting (`id` = meeting ID). Upload endpoints are `false`
in `config.endpoints`. See [Files](#tag/Files).

|---|---|---|---|---|

| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `path` | query | no | `string` |  |
| `temp` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — File manifest (see the Files tag for the shape).

`application/json`:

```ts

    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;
    }>;

      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;
      allowed_extensions?: string[];
      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };

  [key: string]: any;
}
```

### GET /ext/risk_assessments/uploads/

**Risk assessment attachments manifest**

File manifest for documents attached to a risk assessment. See [Files](#tag/Files).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"manifest"` |  |
| `id` | query | yes | `string` | Meeting (or event) ID. |
| `type` | query | yes | `string` | Observed `meeting`. |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `path` | query | no | `string` | Observed `/meeting/`. |
| `temp` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — File manifest (see the Files tag for the shape).

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: {
    manifest?: any[] | Record<string, {
      upload_id?: integer;
      path?: string;
      directory?: string;
      name?: string;
      mime?: string;
      extension?: string;
      bytes?: integer;
      size?: string;
      date_uploaded?: string;
      preview?: string;
      [key: string]: any;

    config?: {
      endpoints?: Record<string, any>;

      allowed_mime?: string[];
      max_file_size?: integer | null;
      single_file_size_limit?: integer | null;
      max_files?: any;  // Integer limit, `null`, or `false` when unlimited.
      chunked_uploads?: boolean;
      [key: string]: any;
    };
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
```

# OSM API — Generic

Cross-cutting helpers (edit locks, telemetry).

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `POST /ext/generic/locks/` — Obtain or clear an edit lock
- `POST /ext/generic/featureusage/` — Record feature usage (telemetry)

### POST /ext/generic/locks/

**Obtain or clear an edit lock**

Advisory locks that stop two leaders editing the same thing at once
(observed for email campaigns, `item=campaign_<campaignId>`).

- `obtain` — returns a `lock_id`; `duration` is in seconds and the UI
  re-obtains periodically while editing.
- `clear` — releases a lock by `lock_id`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"obtain" \| "clear"` |  |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  item?: string;  // `obtain` — what to lock, e.g. `campaign_70001`.
  duration?: string;  // `obtain` — seconds (observed `60`).
  read_allowed?: "true" | "false";  // `obtain` — whether others may read while locked.
  write_allowed?: "true" | "false";  // `obtain` — whether others may write while locked.
  type?: string;  // `obtain` — observed `write`.
  lock_id?: string;  // `clear` — lock to release.
  section_id?: string;
}
```

Example — Obtain a lock:

```json
{
  "item": "campaign_70001",
  "duration": "60",
  "read_allowed": "false",
  "write_allowed": "false",
  "type": "write",
  "section_id": "45002"
}
```

Example — Clear a lock:

```json
{
  "lock_id": "9900001",
  "section_id": "45002"
}
```

**Response 200** — Lock result.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — Lock obtained:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "lock_id": 9900001
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

Example — Lock cleared:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": []
}
```

### POST /ext/generic/featureusage/

**Record feature usage (telemetry)**

UI telemetry — the web app reports actions such as
`viewed attendance register` or `drag drop patrols`. Third-party
integrations have no need to call this.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"add"` |  |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  feature?: string;
  section_id?: string;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "feature": "viewed attendance register",
  "section_id": "45002"
}
```

**Response 200** — Recorded.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```


---

# OSM API — User

Session keep-alive, per-user preferences, and notifications.

Base URL: `https://www.onlinescoutmanager.co.uk`. Auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. POST bodies are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, never JSON. Full context: https://opensource.newcastlescouts.org.uk/llms.txt

## Operations

- `POST /ext/users/auth/` — Session keep-alive ping
- `GET /ext/users/notifications/` — Get user notifications
- `POST /ext/users/notifications/` — Dismiss a notification
- `POST /ext/settings/accountpreferences/` — Set the user's default section
- `GET /v3/menu-preferences/{sectionid}` — Get menu preferences
- `GET /v3/favourites/{sectionid}` — Get favourites

### POST /ext/users/auth/

**Session keep-alive ping**

Polled by the web app to keep the session alive and detect inactivity.
`inactive` appears to be the number of seconds since the user's last
interaction.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"ping"` |  |
| `user_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Ping result.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  inactive?: integer;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "inactive": 34
}
```

### GET /ext/users/notifications/

**Get user notifications**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"get"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — Notifications.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [
    {
      "level": 2,
      "name": "SetRetentionSettings",
      "title": "Review your data retention settings",
      "hide_dismiss": false,
      "dismiss": "SetRetentionSettings-45001-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9",
      "dismiss_expires": "2026-11-17",
      "view_component": false,
      "view_function": false,
      "view_args": [],
      "view_constructor_args": {},
      "use_slider": false,
      "video": false,
      "image": false,
      "data": [
        "Set how long OSM keeps data about members who have left."
      ],
      "skip_if_dialogs_shown": false,
      "actions": [
        {
          "label": "Open settings",
          "component": "settings",
          "view_function": "open",
          "arguments": [
            "retention"
          ],
          "dismiss": "2026-11-17",
          "colour": "blue",
          "icon": "cog",
          "size": "small"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "meta": []
}
```

### POST /ext/users/notifications/

**Dismiss a notification**

Hides a notification until `expires`. `item` is the notification's
`dismiss` key from the GET response
(`<NotificationName>-<sectionId>-<hash>`). The response returns the
remaining `notifications`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"dismiss"` |  |

**Request body** (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, required)

```ts
{
  section_id: string;
  item: string;  // The notification's `dismiss` key.
  expires?: string /* date */;  // Date until which the notification stays hidden (observed one week ahead).
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "section_id": "45001",
  "item": "SetRetentionSettings-45001-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9",
  "expires": "2026-11-17"
}
```

**Response 200** — Notification dismissed.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "hidden": true,
    "notifications": []
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

### POST /ext/settings/accountpreferences/

**Set the user's default section**

Sets which section opens by default after login (the `isDefault` flag in startup `roles`). No request body — everything is in the query string.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | query | yes | `"updateDefaultSection"` |  |
| `section_id` | query | yes | `string` |  |
| `section` | query | yes | `string` | Section type. |

**Response 200** — Default section updated.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": [],
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/menu-preferences/{sectionid}

**Get menu preferences**

The user's customised navigation menu for the section (`hidden` items and custom `order`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |

**Response 200** — Menu preferences.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "hidden": [],
    "order": {}
  },
  "meta": []
}
```

### GET /v3/favourites/{sectionid}

**Get favourites**

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sectionid` | path | yes | `string` | Section ID. |
| `term_id` | query | no | `string` |  |

**Response 200** — The user's favourited items.

`application/json`:

```ts
{
  status?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  data?: any;  // Endpoint-specific payload (object, array, or null).
  meta?: any;  // Endpoint-specific metadata (object, or `[]` when empty).
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

Example — example:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "error": null,
  "data": {
    "items": []
  },
  "meta": []
}
```
